Name: S1–S2 Technology naming consistency
Resolution Notes: CANON LOCK — Display names for S1–S2 power/grid tech. Primary lattice: always “432 Hz Master Carrier Wave” (Furling crystalline subspace anchors). Episode 104 title “Harmonic 432” is narrative; on-screen tech asset label remains 432 Hz Master Carrier Wave. Terrestrial distribution layer: “TCCSG” (Terran Continental/Common Super-Grid) for Earth-side step-down and civilian power. Do not alternate with informal names after Ep 104. Baltic Furling Vault is the origin site, not a separate system name.
